risk_flags.description: The contract commits to a specific micro-optimization without promising to measure or demonstrate that the report command is actually faster. Passing tests only proves behavior stayed covered; it does not satisfy the requester’s performance request.
risk_flags.span: Can you make the report command faster?

risk_flags.description: The proposed direct string slice depends on all stored dates being normalized in exactly that format. The project rules shown here do not state a date-format invariant, so this could silently misfilter older or unusual stored records unless the agent confirms that invariant or adds coverage.
risk_flags.span: direct [:7] string slice on the stored YYYY-MM-DD date field

risk_flags.description: The contract promises only existing tests, but if the date-filtering behavior changes for any accepted input shape, the contribution policy requires a test for that behavior. This matters because the proposed implementation is less general than the existing parse path.
